versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the cst-time skill.
- Offers methods and guidance for obtaining and converting China Standard Time (CST, UTC+8) across major operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS).
- Includes cross-language examples for working with CST time in Python, JavaScript/Node.js, Java, Go, and C#.
- Provides time zone conversion formulas and usage tips.
- Covers formatting options and best practices for handling CST time in applications.
